21099.d: A radiant wisp is a tier 10 wisp harvested in the Divination skill, requiring level 85.

gt.heading: Getting there
gt.text:
From Port Phasmatys

Speak to the Ghost captain standing next to a small row boat at the southern end of the docks in Port Phasmatys to travel to Dragontooth Island. The boat ride is free of charge. It requires ghostspeak amulet or cramulet. If the player has completed all of the hard Morytania achievements, it is not required anymore.
• Ectophial to Port Phasmatys
• Charter ship to Port Phasmatys

Direct teleports
• Direct teleport using Big Book o' Piracy (Pieces of Hate required)
• Direct teleport using one of the relevant Skill Portals in the Max Guild (Ghost's Ahoy required to tune the portal)
• Teleport to the Dragontooth Island resource dungeon using the Hoardstalker ring or Dungeoneering cape
• Direct teleport using elder divination outfit (3 per day)

21129.d: Ralph is the skilling pet for Thieving.
21129.ex: Swag bag ready, this little guy is after all your loot. Watch your pockets!

21130.d: Ralph the sheep hugger is a werewolf who occasionally appears at the Manor Farm.
21130.ex: Has unlimited sheep storage in his cuddle room (not an euphemism for eating them).

21131.d: Ralvash's memory is a memory found during the Mahjarrat Memories miniquest.
21131.ex: The memory whispers the name "Ralvash" in a barely audible voice. You should take it back to Kharshai for transcription.

21139.d: RAM is scenery located in the chaos room of the Elemental Workshop during the Elemental Workshop IV quest.
21139.ex: The chaos machine's ram, used to push cubes into the CPU.

21141.d: RAM upgrade is a music track unlocked during Nomad's Elegy inside the cave where you collect metal and wood for the battering ram.

21142.d: Ramara du Croissant is a woman who is currently living and working at the Piscatoris Fishing Colony, in the metal-working shed, in the northernmost reaches of the kingdom of Kandarin.
21142.ex: A member of the Piscatoris Fishing Colony.

21143.d: Ramarno is one of very few Imcando dwarves to have survived the destruction of the Hall of Camdozaal in the early Fifth Age.

g.label: Entrance to the cavern below Ice Mountain, where the Imcando dwarves once thrived

21145.d: Ramen is a baby goebie who can be found wandering around the village of Kanatah on Mazcab.

21146.d: Rammernauts are members of the Rammernaut Guard, and possible boss monsters fought at the end of a dungeon while training the Dungeoneering skill.
21146.ex: He's big, and he's not pleased to see you.

21147.d: The Ramokee bloodrager is a monster found within Daemonheim, encountered in the Dungeoneering skill.
21147.ex: A former gorajo, exiled for an unspeakable crime.

21148.d: A ramokee bloodrager is one of the monsters Thok fights in the Thok It To 'Em Fremennik Saga, along with three other ramokee.

21149.d: The ramokee bloodragers are monsters involved in the Ramokee Incursion event in Wilderness Flash Events.
21149.ex: A former gorajo, exiled for an unspeakable crime.
